tourWellcome: Hello, I'm Fernando, welcome to the Memori(A)ção museum. Would you like a guided tour of our museum?
startTour: Ok, great choice! To begin, let me explain a little bit about our museum.
You are visiting Memori(A)ção, a virtual museum created to preserve and share the institutional memory of IFSertãoPE Campus Salgueiro.
Here you will find important events, documents, photographs, projects, reports, and other materials that help tell the story of the institution since its creation.
Instead of browsing a regular webpage, you will be able to walk freely through the museum's environments, exploring each room at your own pace and interacting with different objects.
Throughout the visit, whenever you find an interactive object, get closer to it to view information, images, videos, or other content related to the campus's history.
Our visit follows a chronological order. Thus, each environment represents an important stage in building the identity of IFSertãoPE Campus Salgueiro.
Now, follow me to our first stop: the Initial Room, where you will learn about the first steps of the campus's creation and the beginning of this history.
We have arrived! Welcome to our Initial Room.

This is not just a virtualized physical room, but a highly symbolic space. It represents the true ground zero of Campus Salgueiro. It's as if we were stepping on the first virtual brick of our history! Just smell that nostalgia... or is it just digital dust from the servers? Just kidding! Haha.
Looking around, you will notice this main infographic highlighted on the wall.
It works almost like a treasure map or a living timeline, gathering the entire journey, the challenges, and the great achievements of our institution since the very first day.
And to make this experience even richer and more immersive, we prepared a really cool feature: you can listen to a dynamic podcast telling these details while you explore the space calmly.
So, what do you prefer to do now? Would you like to listen to our podcast to dive into this history, or do you prefer that we continue our guided tour through the environments?
yesListenFirstPodcast: Great choice! Below the infographic, there is a blue icon. Click on it to listen to the podcast about the history of our campus.

notListenFirstPodcast: Ok, since you prefer not to listen to our podcast, let me talk a little bit about the beginning of our institution...
It all started back in the foundation phase, in 2007. Our official inauguration happened a bit later, in 2010, and even featured the presence of President Lula.
Soon after, the campus started to expand rapidly. In 2011, we started higher education courses, and by 2013, we were already celebrating our first graduations.
Still in this first decade, we had incredible achievements, such as awards at the Brazilian Physics Olympiad in 2015 and the creation of our Innovation Center in 2016.

Advancing to the Innovation and Inclusion phase, IFSertãoPE crossed borders. In 2017, we had an exchange program to Portugal, and the following year, we launched our first Professional Master's degree.

We also became a technological reference in the Sertão with LabMaker, but one of the milestones that makes us most proud happened in 2022: the graduation of our first blind student, a symbol of our commitment to inclusion.
And looking now to the future, in 2025, diversity continues to be our focus. We maintain important social programs like 'Mulheres Mil' and 'PartiuIF'.
Furthermore, we already have 204 open spots for the 2026 technical courses and fantastic events on the calendar, like the HackaSertão of technology and the Art and Culture Festival.
That is 15 years of great evolution at Campus Salgueiro.

Very well! This was our Initial Room, the space where we got to know the first steps of the creation of Campus Salgueiro and remembered some of the events that marked the beginning of this trajectory.
But every institution is built by people. And it is exactly about them that we will learn a little more now.
Our next stop is the Teaching Room. An environment dedicated to students, teachers, staff, and achievements that helped transform Campus Salgueiro into a reference for the entire region.

introductionOfTeachingRoom: Very well, we have arrived! This is our Teaching Room.
This space was carefully prepared to represent the heart of our campus: education and the transformation of lives.

Having an institution like IFSertãoPE here is of immeasurable importance to our people. We not only offer public technical and higher education of excellence in the heart of the Sertão, but we also create real development opportunities for the entire region, changing the reality of countless families.
So that you can understand a bit more of this dimension, we have four main exhibitions here in this room.
Each of them was handpicked, as they represent very important milestones regarding the evolution of teaching and the academic achievements of our campus over all these years.
To start, right here to my right, you can see this beautiful bookshelf.
Please, follow me...
Currently, it represents the 13 books that feature the authorship or organization of a staff member from our campus.

But, symbolically, this shelf goes much further. It also represents all the very rich knowledge that is generated daily within our institution, whether it be project reports, scientific articles, or our students' Final Course Papers.
And when we talk about valuing books and reading on campus, it is essential to remember the RELEIA project.
RELEIA is a fantastic initiative to encourage reading and writing that moves our academic community, promoting literature and showing that knowledge is also built with imagination and sensitivity.
Among these displayed publications is a very special work produced by the MemoriAção project in 2025: the book 'Memories in Every Space: Campus Salgueiro to Color'.
Inspired by the spaces, stories, and symbols of the campus, the book invites children, youth, and adults to rediscover institutional memory through art.
Each illustration awakens memories, strengthens the feeling of belonging, and shows that preserving history can also be a creative and fun activity.
Now let's get to know another space full of meaning.
Please, follow me...
I ask that you observe this table and the items on it with affection. Together, they form a very beautiful analogy about who really makes our institution happen.
Think of the table itself as a solid, firm base that supports everything above it. This base represents our faculty, our teachers.

Often, in the rush of everyday life, we might end up not measuring the privilege we have here. We are talking about highly qualified professionals, masters, and doctors who are at the top of their academic and professional careers.

In the past, to have contact with teachers of this level, young people from our region had to say goodbye to their families, move to another city, or pay very expensive tuition at private colleges. Today, this excellence is here, accessible, and serving as a foundation for Sertão dreams.

And who are supported by this base? You can see through this main photograph, which represents all our students, whether they are people with disabilities or not. Everyone finds a space for growth here.

Next to the photograph, we have a simple notebook. It may seem like a common object, but it symbolizes something present in all courses on our campus: knowledge. It is where ideas take shape, doubts turn into discoveries, and every written page represents a step in the formation of thousands of students who have passed through this institution.

And speaking of which, we are very proud of our inclusion trajectory. Here on the shelf, for example, we have a photo of Orlando Vidal. He was one of our first deaf students and made a gigantic contribution: he helped create a specific Libras glossary for the food sector!

This seed of inclusion brought us spectacular stories. Like that of Walla Nascimento, who overcame the loss of his vision and became the first blind student to complete a higher education degree here, graduating in Internet Systems in September 2024.

And also of the brilliant Daniel Antônio, a student with cerebral palsy who, using assistive technologies such as eye tracking and adapted keyboards, broke all physical barriers and also graduated in Internet Systems, just now in May 2026. The strength of our students is truly inspiring.

Still on the table, notice this architectural model. It is a beautiful representation of our Technical course in Buildings. Much more than teaching how to build walls, this course trains professionals who build the future of our cities, transforming cement and brick into the infrastructure that our society needs so much.
Finally, look very closely at this photograph of a bus. It might seem like something simple in daily life, but April 20, 2012, was a true watershed in our history.

The arrival of this bus meant that our students would no longer be stuck just in our region. It was a passport to the world! Thanks to it, we opened the doors to unforgettable technical trips, allowing Sertão students to cross borders to experience the reality of other cities and states.

Far beyond practical learning, it was in these seats and on these roads that great friendships were born and precious memories were built... the kind of happy memories we carry for the rest of our lives.
All these elements we've seen here represent only a part of the richness of teaching on our campus. But our trajectory doesn't end here.
Campus Salgueiro offers courses in different areas of knowledge, and each of them was symbolized by a carefully chosen object to represent its identity and contribution to our students' education.
I invite you to walk over to the shelf right there. Let's get to know these symbols and discover how each course helped build our institution's history.
Let's go take a look?
Please follow me
Here we are. Notice this first object resting on the shelf: a small atom model.
It represents the fundamental structure of matter and the continuous search to understand the phenomena of the universe.
It's the perfect symbol for our Physics Degree course.
The history of this degree is marked by pioneering and inclusion. The first graduated student in the history of Campus Salgueiro, Luís Cícero Bezerra, came from here.
The course also transformed the lives of students like Andreia Freire and Daiane Ribeiro.
After participating in initiation projects at the institution's Science Museum, they were approved as teachers.
In addition to its scientific basis, the course demonstrated a great social commitment by promoting inclusive classes.
Physics concepts were taught with paintings and games to young people with intellectual disabilities from Apae
There was also the adaptation of methodologies and resources for the learning of students with cerebral palsy.
Science has an enormous power to transform society.
This leads us to look at the next object right here on our shelf, where chemistry and practical life meet.
Right next to it, look at this Erlenmeyer flask.
Being a classic laboratory container, it illustrates the union between chemistry, biology, and innovation.
In our collection, it symbolizes the Food Technology higher education course.
The greatest victories of this course lie in the stories of its students.
Students like Daiana Vieira and Alane Barros brought academic knowledge directly to society.
They created a project that trained sixty low-income women in Cedro for the professional production of cakes and savory snacks.
The course also broke great accessibility barriers.
Deaf student Cícero Vidal created a pioneering glossary in Libras containing over four hundred technical terms in the field.
The training even opened borders around the world!
It took students like Leandro Fonseca for internships in the United States and alumnus Clemilson Elpídio to a doctorate in Spain.
From food transformation, we now move on to digital transformation.
You can check this out by paying attention to our last item on this shelf.
Observe this notebook carefully.
It is the global symbol of connectivity, programming logic, and the human capacity to build digital solutions.
Here, it represents our higher education course in Internet Systems Technology.
The creation of this course marked the important step of verticalizing education at Campus Salgueiro.
This allowed IT technicians to continue their graduation at the institution itself
The commitment to academic excellence guaranteed the course a great score of 4 in the Ministry of Education's evaluation.
The trajectory of its students is also very inspiring!
Student José Neto represented the institute internationally through the Lapassion project.
And Elizandro do Nascimento was awarded for developing sustainable innovations in a challenge promoted by Compesa.
One of the most emotional milestones of the course was the graduation of Walla Nascimento.
He became the first blind student to complete a degree on our campus.
With this notebook, we close the stories of this shelf of ours, but our visit continues.
Follow me to our main exhibition in the teaching room!
Please follow me
We have reached our last stop in this teaching room, and what we have before us is much more than a simple board or summary of data.
This infographic of the MemoriAção project is the portrait of 15 years of dreams planted and harvested in the heart of the Pernambuco Sertão.
It invites us to travel back in time, returning to 2010, when the first seeds of knowledge were cast with the pioneering Subsequent Technical course in Agriculture.
The very next year, we saw hope bloom with the arrival of Integrated High School and our first degrees in Physics and Food Technology.
This tree of knowledge grew strong, and in 2018, we reached the historic step of Postgraduate studies, embracing the ProfEPT master's degree.
Today, looking at the milestone of 2025, we celebrate new and beautiful academic horizons, opening our arms to Civil Engineering and Internet Systems.
But I ask that you observe the numbers next to it with great affection, as they tell us silent stories of care, dignity, and empathy.
In a decade, 2,437 student aids were granted, ensuring that food, transportation, and shelter were never obstacles for those who wish to succeed through their studies.
It is a profound legacy where science and the community embrace, transforming the local reality through records in research and the strength of extension.
This is a trajectory made of people, of overcoming, and of a profound love for inclusive and liberating education.
And so that you can feel the emotion of all these achievements even closer, we have prepared something special.
A podcast narrating the institution's main milestones regarding education.
So, do you wish to continue our visit and head to the next room, or do you prefer to take a break here and listen to the podcast first?
